conventions.convention: Contraction and norm are Frobenius: S:T = tr(SᵀT), |S|² = S:S. The Bingham parameter τ_y is the radius of the trace-free symmetric stress ball at zero strain rate; other invariant normalizations require parameter conversion.

Generalized Newtonian viscosity is finite, continuous and nonnegative on [0,∞). The unregularized power viscosity is defined only at positive shear rate, with stress separately extended by zero at D = 0.
Objectivity means orthogonal conjugation at corresponding events under C² rigid observer changes x* = Q(t)x + c(t), Q(t) ∈ SO(3).
Conformation positivity is asserted forward on [0,T] from positive-definite C(0), with G > 0, λ > 0 and η_s ≥ 0. Endpoint derivatives are one-sided.

The entropy conclusion additionally assumes constant thermostat temperature T₀ > 0, energy balance e_v′ = (τ_s + τ_p):D − h, Helmholtz identification w = e_v − T₀s_v, and entropy production π_s = s_v′ + h/T₀; positive h denotes heat removal.
The resting-stress example establishes constitutive graph membership only, without asserting force balance, material realization or empirical observation.

load_bearing.statement: Defines the selected smooth constitutive branches: τ = 2η(γ̇)D; the Frobenius-normalized Bingham graph with its full rest-stress ball; and the incompressible pathwise conformation equation C′ = LC + CLᵀ − (C − I₃)/λ, stresses τ_p = G(C − I₃), τ_s = 2η_sD, and storage w(C) = G(tr C − log det C − 3)/2. These selected equations assert neither empirical applicability nor PDE solution existence.

Under its stated smooth incompressible trajectory hypotheses, symmetric conformation solution with C(0) positive definite, G, λ > 0 and η_s ≥ 0, C(t) remains positive definite for t ∈ [0,T], and (τ_s + τ_p):D − w′ = 2η_sD:D + G(tr C + tr C⁻¹ − 6)/(2λ) ≥ 0. The equation is observer-covariant, stresses transform by conjugation and storage is invariant.

For μ_p, τ_y ≥ 0 on trace-free symmetric matrices, the stated Bingham graph is the subdifferential of Φ(D) = μ_p|D|² + τ_y|D|, is monotone, has τ:D ≥ 0 for every graph value, and satisfies B(QDQᵀ) = QB(D)Qᵀ. Its zero-rate value is the full Frobenius ball of radius τ_y.
For the stated incompressible smooth motion and finite continuous η:[0,∞)→[0,∞), τ = 2η(γ̇)D satisfies τ:D ≥ 0 and transforms objectively under C² rigid observer changes.
